# Nomara Voyages — نومارا للسياحة والأسفار

> Licensed travel agency in Aïn M'Lila, Oum El Bouaghi, Algeria, specializing in
> **Umrah & Hajj** and **organized group tours**, all departing directly from
> **Constantine Airport (Mohamed Boudiaf)**. One clear all-inclusive price (flight +
> hotel + on-trip guide; for Umrah, visa included). Booking is via WhatsApp/phone —
> there is no online checkout. Arabic-first; French spoken. Founder & on-trip guide:
> Haddad Youssef Islam (حدّاد يوسف إسلام).

## Key facts
- Name (AR): نومارا للسياحة و خدمات الحج و العمرة · (Latin): Nomara Voyages
- Base: حي الغزالي، عين مليلة، أم البواقي، الجزائر (04003)
- Departure hub: مطار قسنطينة / Constantine Airport — convenient for eastern Algeria
- Contact: WhatsApp & phone +213 661 45 70 25 · Instagram @nomara.voyages
- Pricing policy: transparent, all-inclusive, never "starting from"; optional extras stated up front
- Honesty policy: we do not guarantee visa approval (the consulate decides); we prepare a clean file

## Organized tours (indicative prices in DZD — confirm the latest on WhatsApp)
- Tunisie (Djerba & Sousse): from ~36,000 (Sousse Mantago) to ~55,000 (Djerba/Sidi Mansour) — 7 nights
- Turquie (Istanbul): ~119,000 — 7 nights, 4★ hotel + tours
- Azerbaïdjan (Baku): ~119,000 — 7 nights, 4★ hotel + tours
- Malaisie (Kuala Lumpur + islands): ~199,000
- Égypte (Cairo + Hurghada "Collection Mirage"): price on request; seasonal −25% offer
- All tour prices include: round-trip flight from Constantine + hotel + airport transfers + Nomara guide

## Umrah & Hajj (Sakina)
- Umrah Shawwal & June departures, direct from Constantine, hotels tiered by distance to the Haram
- Indicative Umrah range ~198,000–235,000 DZD by hotel; price includes flight + hotel + guide + visa
- Hajj: guidance through the rites with an accompanying guide

## Services
- Organized tours · Umrah & Hajj · hotel reservation · flight ticketing · visa-file assistance
